reports.title: ZIM Reports Industry Leading Third Quarter 2026 Profitability, Driven

guidance.heading: Full-Year 2026 Guidance
section: In 2026, the Company expects to generate Adjusted EBITDA between $3.3 billion and $3.5 billion and Adjusted EBIT between $2.0 and $2.2 billion. Previously the Company expected to generate Adjusted EBITDA of between $2.7 billion and $3.0 billion and Adjusted EBIT of between $1.4 billion and $1.7 billion.
